findings.body: The added assertions only verify `appliedMeasureFilters`. Nothing verifies that `ChatResponseDto.selection` references `ExplorationSelectionDto`, so reverting that property to the previous generic object schema would leave this test green. The existing production-Swagger test only checks the shared selection component, which is also registered by saved-query routes and therefore does not prove `/api/chat` uses it. Add an assertion against the chat response schema or its `selection` metadata so the required `selection.measureFilters` documentation cannot regress unnoticed.
findings.title: Not done: Swagger test for selection.measureFilters on chat responses
